notes:
ADDED 2026-10-25. A rl of Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 4.206 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-09-25.

CORRECTION, and it matters. The card withdrew its own headline: an earlier version reported 82.9% on the full 121-instance generalization set, and a 2026-09-29 post-release audit found 27 of those instances had entered the training pool before measurement. The corrected figures are 68.1% instance-level / 60.8% per-attempt on the 94 genuinely held-out instances, against 7.0% for the base on the same 94. The 60.8% row below is the corrected per-attempt number; the withdrawn 82.9% is NOT recorded. The same 94 instances went 7.0% -> 60.8%, which is still a large gain. 

PREVIEW: the repo is flagged a research preview, not production-ready, with a known issue where the model runs `git checkout`/`git restore`/`git stash` and can lose uncommitted work. Terminal-Bench 2.1 is the one table row where it loses to the base (11.2 vs 14.6) and is deliberately not recorded.

DUPLICATE NOTE: jsbaicenter/JSBAI-Coder-4B is this same model under its old name - the old repo's card is headed 'This model has moved' and points here. Only one record was created.
